name: Audio Trim & Cut
description: Audio Trimmer & Format Converter with an interactive visual waveform.

howToUse:
1. Drop your audio file into the workspace.
2. Drag the edges of the highlighted region on the waveform to trim.
3. Select your Target Format.
4. Click 'EXPORT' to process and download.
features:
• Interactive Waveform
• MP3 & WAV Export
• Seamless Export
